source: User request to increase Rift Heart rewards, events and shops; local code and fixture-only report exports.
basis: Campaign: Rift Heart ordinary offers 10% -> 20%; eligible foreign-card event weights 1x -> 3x; future map crossed merchants 7.5% -> 22.5%. Fight shards stay -25%. Existing maps/offers persist. No combat rules changed.
evaluationScope: All 30 Ascendancies and freely mixed decks. No real player observations available: .wrangler/report-qa/samples.json is fixture-only; campaign-report-preview/snapshots.json contains dummy IDs. No simulations run. Carried Arena grades are earlier hand estimates, not validation of stronger acquisition.
target: Typical Arena games of 10 or more own turns and roughly 50% or better Drago clears with optimized decks remain playtest targets.

ratings.name: Paladin
ratings.setup: More opportunities to assemble foreign-card synergies after acquiring Rift Heart; paying for them remains constrained by -25% fight shards.
ratings.recovery: More choice may supply defense or recovery; foreign cards can also be unusable without their supporting mechanics.
ratings.rareReliance: Rarity rates unchanged; more foreign-card selection can help mixed engines but guarantees no rare.
ratings.scaling: Fight opening and extended strength depend on the acquired deck. No direct combat multiplier; no new 11+ turn growth engine.
ratings.rationale: All classes can use Rift Heart. Native engine density competes with foreign utility. Arena combat unchanged, but imported Campaign decks may have more mixing opportunities.
ratings.watch: Compare single-class and freely mixed damage, defense, resource and Consume engines at equal deck quality across campaign bands and Arena seats.
ratings.confidence: Low; deterministic checks verify selection rules only.
ratings.pacing: No measured change to 10+ own-turn Arena pacing or Drago clears.

corrections: Previous snapshot preserved. This is acquisition balance, not a direct combat buff or measured grade change.
Tripling event weight does not triple normalized probability. Eligibility, elite-event interception, ambush rules and promised treasure remain unchanged.
Existing maps are not rerolled; swapping Hearts affects future generation only. All 30 styles retain previous unmeasured Arena reference grades.
